content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of the starting index for retrieving coordinator actions in descending order. The original implementation used a parameter named `start`, which was not correctly adjusted when fetching the latest actions. The patch corrected this by renaming the parameter to `offset` and ensuring that the correct offset value was used in the query to retrieve actions, thus returning the latest actions instead of the earliest when the `-info desc` option was specified.
